question: Can the 2 frozen mixed-r students transfer precisely one hitherto untrained numeric data bit in the second answer word while preserving r1 output?
single_factor: For fixed model, seed, r, a, c=d=0, change only b from v=16..21 to v+8=24..29. Its 5-bit data code differs in exactly the bit of numeric value 8 (2nd MSB). All other raw question bits unchanged. r1 correct output must be invariant; r2 correct output must flip exactly the corresponding second-word bit.

profile: SLE-AE1-n5-v1: Q=01+010+r(3 info bits)+0+4*(5 info bits+0)+END(111100), 39 binary chars, legal data ID0..29; END30 and UP31 reserved. A first r full 6-bit words + external S; r in {1,2}. True A generated by deterministic codec only for scoring, not model input.
split: Original PR40 low base train/val/test uses (a+b)%6 (24/6/6 low pairs x r1/r2). Supplement high15..23 x a0..3 used in training with r split, a4 original high validation and a5 original high test. Current probe uses all a0..5 paired with v16..21 vs untrained v24..29; per original split a0..3 is exposure context and a4/5 is preserved heldout-partner context, NOT a newly researcher-blind independent test. None of v24..29 were in PR40 training payloads.
samples: 2 seeds x 6 a-values(0..5) x 6 base v(16..21) x 2 r-values(1,2) x 2 b-domains = 288 real NN generated outputs, forming 144 input-bit-toggle matched pairs. For each of the four (a-group exposed/heldout, r) strata, report exact, word1, word2, STOP and pair-output difference.
model: Frozen float32 [input160,hidden64 tanh, output3] MLP, 10499 parameters. Greedy student-generated prefix, max32 actions, context max80. No label/oracle/teacher at inference.

primary_gate: Among a={4,5}, each seed must have baseline r1 and r2 exact=12/12. To call transfer successful, each seed must satisfy: novel r2 exact>=9/12; paired r2 second-word predicted bit8 flip with other 5 data bits preserved>=9/12; novel r1 exact>=11/12 and r1 prediction invariant relative to baseline>=11/12. Report every result regardless of failure; no model or epoch tuning.
